name: yylo-skills
author: yylo-dev
description: Eight production skills for AI coding agents — Kanban/task lifecycle, work planning, project understanding, single-task execution, benchmarking, wiki, workflow, and artifact records — from the YYLO CLI orchestrator for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi.
long_description_md:
## What it does

**yylo-skills** is the official skill pack for [YYLO](https://github.com/yylo-dev/yylo) — a command-line orchestrator for coding agents with typed task, validation, merge, and release-readiness boundaries. Each task runs in a dedicated branch/worktree behind the YYLO merge queue, and these eight skills expose that lifecycle to AI coding agents as plain `skills/<slug>/SKILL.md` files (the agentskills spec — no proprietary manifest needed):

- **ledger-tasks-yylo** — universal record retrieval plus Kanban task/dependency management
- **plan-ledger-tasks-yylo** — turn a request into a Product Development Requirement and implementation-sized tasks
- **understand-project-yylo** — inspect architecture, dependencies, and validation loops before changing code
- **ralph-loop-yylo** — execute exactly one assigned task to a validated queued commit
- **benchmark-yylo** — prepare cases, compare models/harnesses, evaluate retained outputs with receipts
- **wiki-yylo** — durable project knowledge as revision-safe wiki Records
- **workflow-yylo** — validated workflow Records with storage/execution/evidence boundaries
- **artifact-yylo** — capture and retrieve immutable, secret-safe artifact evidence

## Install

```
./install-skill-pack yylo-dev/yylo-skills
```

The skills drive the `yy` CLI (`npm install --global @yylo-cli/cli` is the runtime prerequisite; installing the skills does not install the CLI). They are written for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi harnesses and follow the same SKILL.md format Aeon consumes natively.

skills.name: ledger-tasks-yylo
skills.description: Retrieve any YYLO Ledger Record by ID, discover PDRs and artifacts, and manage tasks and dependencies. Use for unknown record types, universal get/search, task operations, and source-of-truth boundaries.

skills.name: plan-ledger-tasks-yylo
skills.description: Create a concise Product Development Requirement and one or more implementation-sized YYLO Ledger tasks when the user explicitly asks to plan or register work.

skills.name: understand-project-yylo
skills.description: Inspect the current product architecture, dependencies, and validation loops before planning or implementing a requested change.

skills.name: ralph-loop-yylo
skills.description: Execute exactly one explicitly assigned YYLO Ledger task through the Ralph loop to a validated queued commit. Use only when the user explicitly requests ralph-loop-yylo.

skills.name: benchmark-yylo
skills.description: Prepare reviewed cases, compare models and harnesses, and independently evaluate retained outputs with YYLO Benchmark's thin trusted-host runner.

skills.name: wiki-yylo
skills.description: Use YYLO Ledger wiki Records as durable project knowledge. Search before creating, classify information correctly, and make revision-safe Markdown updates without editing Ledger storage directly.

skills.name: workflow-yylo
skills.description: Create and maintain validated YYLO Ledger workflow Records while keeping storage, execution, and run evidence as separate explicit boundaries.

skills.name: artifact-yylo
skills.description: Capture and retrieve durable YYLO Ledger artifact Records with intentional profiles, payload modes, provenance, retention, and secret-safe immutable evidence.
